text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: The 1600m turf 'Mile Championship'! My biggest rival is definitely her...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yes, an energetic mood-maker!
A sprint Umamusume famous for her explosive front-running—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Man, my heart's racing!
Looking forward to working with you today!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Aha, but like, you're chilling, right?
Totally Chill-haeuser~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Honestly, I'm pretty maxed out here,
but I can't win if I wimp out!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Today's goal: win with a blazing, rainbow-tier runaway lead,
then head home to party with my besties and go 'Whaaat's up!'"
